decisions.reason: Location-specific reporting does not alter payment-processing placement or payment-setup isolation, which are already captured by the candidate's message 39 INTRODUCE.
The separate Wix-account model is already fully established by the candidate's message 39 INTRODUCE; the reporting-placement update requires no additional account-state change.
The candidate's message 39 INTRODUCE already captures a separate Wix website for each location, and location-specific reporting adds no further website-model change.
Reporting placement does not change payout isolation or payout setup; the payout consequences of the architecture are already captured by the candidate's message 39 events.
Location-specific reporting does not modify calendar isolation or placement, and the candidate already has a message 39 MODIFY for its location-specific calendar placement.
The reporting-placement update does not change booking management or booking placement, which are already represented by the candidate's message 39 MODIFY.
Location-specific reporting does not alter visitor location discovery or routing, and the message 39 routing change is already captured under this candidate.
The reporting-placement update neither changes legacy-site availability nor adds to the master-site linkage already captured by the candidate's message 39 MODIFY.
The placement of location reporting has no necessary effect on SEO preservation or migration handling.
The reporting-placement update does not change the existing master website domain or domain-to-website mapping.
Location-specific reporting is compatible with the existing expansion capability but does not necessarily modify the expansion or template requirements.
The reporting architecture does not change the visual-layout reference, navigation style, or application of the competitor design reference.
